0022600225.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-3, 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, 3rd in the West, on an eight-game winning streak) visit the Houston Rockets (8-3, 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, 5th in the West, on a one-game winning streak) in the Warriors' 12th game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost 1-2 in the season series, including a 117-116 loss in San Francisco on April 5, 2026. Golden State is missing Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain).
